identification: Mid-century (signed and dated 1954) locally made timber 20-drawer workshop/collector's cabinet: painted carcase in mottled green (sprayed/sponged finish), two columns of 10 slightly graduated drawers with pressed-metal cup pulls and small brass card-label holders, drawers internally divided with timber partitions (2 to 5 compartments), plywood back/side panel with pencil 'H Thomas 25/11 1954', hinged black steel locking bar down the centre with modern padlock and key, on four castors. Catalogue size H150 W102 D50 cm. Timber, not steel (cloud scan's 'industrial' is right in style; carcase is timber/ply).
